title: Balsa installed source manifest
description: Provenance for every registry item installed into a project. Records where source came from, what it was when it arrived, and what Balsa layered on top, so an update can separate upstream change from local change.

registry.description: Fully qualified item reference, for example @balsa/button or @shadcn/button.

namespace.description: Registry namespace the item was resolved from.

origin.description: Resolved registry URL for items not published by Balsa itself.

upstreamVersion.description: Version declared by the source registry, when it declares one.

contractVersion.description: Version of the Balsa component specification describing this item.

adapterVersion.description: Version of the Balsa theme adapter applied to an upstream item.

designSystemVersion.description: Balsa release whose design system was active at install time.

originalSourceHash.description: Hash of the source as published, before any local edit.

installedSourceHash.description: Hash of the source as written to disk. Divergence from the files on disk means the consumer edited them.
